title: the settling's final review: the budget does not bind, sector 0 is unreachable on a settled opening, the record corrected
context: The whole-branch review of the-settling (9bf675cb..2aca69a4) found the code consistent and the record wrong in two places. The budget does not bind: every run starts with GAME_START_BIOMASS 170 (src/domain/campaign.js) and the salvage lands on top of it, so the bank at the first orders is 266 / 350 / 410 kg by grade (WRECK / automatic or HARD / CLEAN; --settling measured 350), and the dearest pair of cards is 180, so every grade buys any two, while the content comment, a test message and STATE said a WRECK could not buy the array and the player chose out of 180 kg. Sector 0 plays on no settled opening whatever the settle's length: a Rotor bought at the card (which opens once the Stålheart's print has begun) and Isao's emergency Rotor both queue behind the Stålheart's 75 s print and the tremor waits for the Rotor, while spec 2.D still offered a shorter settle as the lever. Three suites whose paths changed were unrun (--chapters, --skip-tutorial, --round23). Smaller: the dead gunshipCalled flag, the variable `settled` read as the phase, rotor_emergency and scout_material missing from the director board, story-entry.js's comment on the chapters' first steps (the array, now `when: foundry`, prints with the opening in the wave, quiver and stalheart chapters), no test of the chapter's replayed print or of firstOffers' edges, two stale suite header comments, the owner's facts found in the suite recorded nowhere.
outcome: Record and tests only, no design change (the start bank, the prices and the Rotor's place in Isao's queue are untouched). src/content/build-board.js states the pure rule's numbers and that the page's 170 kg start bank sits under the salvage, so in play every grade affords any pair; test/build-board.mjs says its 96 kg case is the pure rule, asserts openStoryAt replays a chapter's printed step once with { replay: true } (a regression would grant the recycler's 60 kg on every chapter start) and covers firstOffers with rotorCell undefined / -1 and offers: 2; test/build-programme.mjs's appended block re-indented. src/domain/story-beats.js: gunshipCalled removed, `settled` renamed `settling` (behaviour unchanged). src/content/director.js places rotor_emergency and scout_material in ROTOR (beat `printing`), asserted in test/director-board.mjs. src/fx/story-entry.js's comment says the array now prints right after the pad in the wave, quiver and stalheart chapters. scripts/browser-test.mjs: the --settling header's page 2 is &settle=16, --grow's header the settled order, and the grow-landing page's wait restored (Task 4's comment had swallowed its `await until`). STATE and spec 2.B / 2.D say the budget does not bind and sector 0 plays on no settled opening, and STATE's open calls gain: the zero start bank or dearer prices; buying the Rotor is the losing move (Isao grants its 45 kg if skipped and the first contact waits for it either way); the Rotor-after-Stålheart order is timing, not a rule; rotor_emergency's line comes about a minute before the Rotor on short settles; the controls card through the board's panel; no thumbnails for the pad, foundry and array tiles. The suites: --chapters PASS 8, --skip-tutorial PASS 11, --round23 FAIL at its first assertion (7.9 cells, wants 8-16) identically on the base, so it predates the branch; --pacing not run.
alternatives: A zero start bank on a settled opening (or dearer first-order prices) so the salvage is the whole budget and the grades bind: not pulled, the economy is the owner's call.

Hold the Stålheart until the first orders close (or let a sentry order interrupt a print) so a bought Rotor stands first and a short settle brings sector 0 back: not pulled, the opening's design and pacing are the owner's call.
